newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-REIFFEL AND GILLESPIE OUT OF ASHES TOUR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-REIFFEL AND GILLESPIE OUT OF ASHES TOUR.

text.p: Australian fast bowlers Jason Gillespie and Paul Reiffel were ruled out of the sixth and final test against England which begins at the Oval next week.

Reiffel, who arrived as a replacement for the injured Andy Bichel, has returned to Australia because of problems with his wife's pregnancy. He played in four tests on tour taking 11 wickets and hitting a career best 54 at Leeds.

Gillespie, who missed the Lord's test because of a groin injury, aggravated a back strain during the fifth test at Trent Bridge and will not bowl again on tour. His 16 test wickets included seven for 37 in the fourth test at Leeds.
They are likely to be replaced by Michael Kasprowicz, who played in the first two tests, and Brendon Julian.
Australia have already retained the Ashes and lead the series 3-1.
